title: Legislative procedure and joint sitting
quote: Every Money Bill is a Financial Bill, but not every Financial Bill is a Money Bill

boxes.title: Ordinary bill stages
steps: Second House: pass, amend, reject or hold **6 months**
President (**Art. 111**): assent, withhold or return once

boxes.title: Money Bill (Arts. 109, 110)
items: ==**Only in Lok Sabha**==, by minister, President's prior recommendation
Taxes, borrowing, **Consolidated Fund**; fines/fees **not** money bills
RS: recommend within **14 days**; cannot amend/reject

boxes.title: Joint sitting (Art. 108)
items: Summoned by **President**; presided by ==**LS Speaker**== (not VP)
Grounds: rejection, disagreement on amendments, **6 months** delay
Simple majority of members present & voting; quorum **one-tenth**

boxes.title: Lapse on LS dissolution
head: Lapses
Does not lapse
rows: Pending in RS, not passed by LS
Passed by RS, pending in LS

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Money Bill only by minister in LS (APPSC-GS 2019)
"Passed by LS, not taken up in RS does not lapse" = **false** (APPSC-G1 2024)
AP: Andhra State Bill **10 Aug 1953**, assent **14 Sep 1953**
